conbody.p: Press ? beside the notification bell to open the help panel. It shows the page of this manual for the screen you are on, written for the release your workspace is on, so what it describes matches what you see. Links between pages open in the panel, Back returns, and the search box at the top searches the whole manual. Open in the docs opens the same page on the docs site, where a menu lets you read the manual for other releases.

Help also follows what you are doing on the page. It opens on the part of the manual for the section you are working in, the button you pressed last or the tab you are on, where the manual has one, and on the page's own topic otherwise: in project settings, the Members tab opens Project access (members) and the Share links card opens Share links; an artifact's History button opens Editing, versions & history, its figures open Figures, and the History and V&V Assistant tabs of the Notes panel open theirs. While the panel is open it moves with you, a moment after you change section or tab. Once you follow a link or search in the panel, it stays on what you chose until you go to another page or open it again. Only which section of the screen you are in is used to choose the page, never anything you have typed.
